patch_description: This crossover keeps the stronger broad dirty-cell targeting strategy from the current program while incorporating exact cheapest-detour insertion from the inspiration program. It also replaces the expensive nested visit-time vectors and repeated route validation with a flat route representation, precomputed adjacency/APSP parents, and O(L) gap-based scoring. This allows substantially more simulated-annealing iterations within the same time limit while preserving legal cyclic routes.
